title: Six-parameter input uncertainty propagation through the Holtrop-Mennen calm-water resistance regression: uncertainty band + Sobol' ranking + Monte Carlo acceleration
notes: Geometric (L, B, T, Cb, lcb) and operational (V) uncertainty of an early-design bulk-carrier case; the black box is the published Holtrop-Mennen (1982/1984) regression module already in the repository. Uncertainty levels: L 0.5%, B 0.3%, T 2%, Cb 1%, V 2% (1 sigma), lcb -2%L +-0.5%L. The reference moments come from a 2e5 scrambled-Sobol QMC run so that the Monte Carlo noise floor can be separated from the surrogate error. Configuration choice: quadratic (order 2) sparse-projection PCE on a Smolyak level-2 grid (13 model evaluations, exact to total degree 3). The cost/accuracy sweep in the ledger shows the neighbouring configurations (level 3 -> 97 evaluations, 0.05% moment error; level 4 -> 533 evaluations, 0.015%) so the chosen accuracy is not a lucky single point.
